images.seen: 29 culture polities drawn (Yamnaya on the Pontic-Caspian steppe to the Urals, Longshan/Qujialing/Dawenkou/Hongshan in China, Hoabinhian over mainland SE Asia, Early Dynastic Egypt on the Nile); no holes, no stray speckle outside regions, no jumps; Cliopatria holds only Egypt, Sumer, Elam and one Indus dot, so the cultures are compiler-only and nothing contradicts them
identical to -3000 apart from the events of -3000 (Naqada and Cucuteni-Trypillia gone, Longshan in Yangshao's 1935 cells, Ebla and Ahar-Banas new); still no jumps, holes or stray cells

Early Dynastic Egypt from Delta to Aswan, Ebla, Sumerian city-states, Elam all plausible; A-Group is drawn as a desert rectangle at 21.0-22.8N, 30.0-33.4E (134 cells) with one detached cell near 33E 22.9N, while the Nile stretch between Aswan and the Egyptian border (22.8-24N) is empty (see issues)

issues.what: A-Group culture (134 cells) is the gazetteer polygon 'Lower Nubia' minus the Upper Egypt Nile band and the Cliopatria Early Dynastic -3000 shape, so it falls as a Sahara rectangle south of 22.8N (mostly south of Wadi Halfa) and leaves the Aswan-to-border Nile stretch unclaimed; the culture's Nile valley between the First and Second Cataracts is only partly covered. The cause is the dossier's own cut (written to avoid the Naqada/Early Dynastic Nile band that reaches south of the First Cataract in the gazetteer). The one keyframe a-group-culture_-3500 spans -3500..-2900, starts in the earlier windows (m3500-m3401 first), and a fix would be an override of that whole keyframe (intersect Lower Nubia with the Nile 40 km band, minus the Early Dynastic shape: 85 cells, 21.0-23.9N) that also alters five earlier windows and the Naqada overlap there. The brief says to agree with neighbouring windows before overriding a keyframe that starts outside the window, which I cannot do, so I did not patch. The shape is a small, low-stakes cultural zone; no page was opened.

Everything else in the window: no size-rule conflicts, no keyframe snaps, no skipped or unresolved events, no vassal/colony/contest relations, no hierarchy rows for any state alive. The single changed year (-3000, 5394 cells) is the hand-over of Yangshao to Longshan (1935 cells), the end of Naqada (842) and of Cucuteni-Trypillia (824, Odessa/Kirovohrad cells gained by Yamnaya), and the starts of Ebla and Ahar-Banas; all ledger-explained.

problems: a-group-culture: keyframe a-group-culture_-3500 (-3500..-2900) is drawn as a Lower Nubia desert rectangle at 21.0-22.8N and misses the Aswan-to-Wadi Halfa Nile (22-24N); a keyframe override with {intersect: [Lower Nubia, river Nile 40 km]} minus the Cliopatria Early Dynastic -3000 shape would give 85 cells at 21.0-23.9N, but the keyframe starts outside this window and belongs to m3500-m3401 first, so I left it for the orchestrator or that window's agent to decide.
